"# RED TEAM V2 — Premium Developer Visual UI Walkthrough

We have completely redesigned the command line terminal interface and branding, replacing the old, clunky, panel-based layout with an **exceedingly clean, high-contrast, minimalist hacker TUI** inspired by elite terminal developer applications (like `lazygit` and `k9s`).

## What Changed

### 1. Correct Branding & Clean Monospace ASCII Banner (`utils/display.py`)
* **RED TEAM V2 Branding**: Purged all references to the outdated `"GHOSTWIRE"` naming across the visual interfaces.
* **Premium Monospace ASCII Logo**: Implemented an extremely crisp, 70-column monospace ASCII text banner for **`RED TEAM V2`** that is perfectly aligned and safe from wrapping on standard 80-column terminals.
* **Modern Subtitles**: Added a clean single-line header tag: `[ RED TEAM V2 ] // Autonomous Cyber Intelligence Framework // v2.1.0`.

### 2. Sleek Dark Cyberpunk Palette (`utils/display.py`)
* Transitioned from plain, generic colors to a beautifully curated **Tokyo Night / Nord Cyberpunk** palette:
  - Tokyo Night Blue (`#7aa2f7`)
  - Tokyo Night Lavender (`#bb9af3`)
  - Matrix Emerald Green (`#9ece6a`)
  - Warm Amber (`#e0af68`)
  - Crimson Coral (`#f7768e`)
  - Deep Slate Gray (`#565f89`)
  - High-Contrast Light Lavender (`#acb0d0`)

### 3. Modern High-Contrast Diagnostics Badges (`utils/display.py`)
* **Badge Indicators**: Diagnostics and checks now render as solid high-contrast status blocks: `[  PASS  ]` (white on green background), `[  WARN  ]` (black on yellow background), and `[  FAIL  ]` (white on red background).
* **Perfect Alignment**: Designed a custom alignment utility that renders elegant leader dots (`...`) to justify all status badges perfectly to the right side of the screen at exactly 65 characters.
